versions.content: If SecOC has received both an Authentic I - PDU and a Cryptographic PDU and the verification of the resulting Secured I - PDU fails, both the Authentic and Cryptographic I - PDU shall remain buffered and verification shall be reattempted each time new data for a ny of them is received.
